in_marathi.name: Rajash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler, King, Leader
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rajas meaning 'ruler' or 'king' in Sanskrit. Derived from the root word 'raj', meaning 'to rule'. A name for a powerful and courageous leader, one who commands respect and obedience.
